38100.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of nirodhattha
38100.meaning1: for the sake of ending; for the purpose of cessation

examples.text: atha kho idaṃ, bhikkhave, brahmacariyaṃ vussati saṃvar'atthaṃ pahān'atthaṃ virāg'atthaṃ nirodh'atthan'ti.

38101.meaning1: having the nature to end; subject to cessation; liable to end

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma suddhaṃ vatthaṃ apagatakāḷakaṃ samma'd'eva rajanaṃ paṭiggaṇheyya, evam'eva yasassa kulaputtassa tasmiṃ'y'eva āsane virajaṃ vītamalaṃ dhammacakkhuṃ udapādi, yaṃ kiñci samudayadhammaṃ, sabbaṃ taṃ nirodhadhamman'ti.
tadāhāranirodhā yaṃ bhūtaṃ taṃ nirodhadhamman'ti yathābhūtaṃ sammappaññāya disvā nirodhadhammassa nibbidāya virāgāya nirodhāya paṭipanno hoti. evaṃ kho, bhante, sekkho hoti.

38102.meaning1: fact of having a nature to end; liability to cessation

examples.text: taṃ kho pan'etaṃ, bhikkhu, mayā saṅkhārānaṃ'y'eva khayadhammataṃ … vayadhammataṃ … virāgadhammataṃ … nirodhadhammataṃ … vipariṇāmadhammataṃ sandhāya bhāsitaṃ, yaṃ kiñci vedayitaṃ taṃ dukkhasmin'ti. atha kho pana, bhikkhu, mayā anupubbasaṅkhārānaṃ nirodho akkhāto.

38106.meaning1: state of cessation; epithet of Nibbāna

examples.text: aparā'pi tisso dhātuyo, rūpadhātu, arūpadhātu, nirodhadhātu.
rūpadhātu, arūpadhātu, nirodhadhātu, imā kho, bhikkhave, tisso dhātuyo'ti. etam'atthaṃ bhagavā avoca.

38108.meaning1: based on ending; supported by cessation; by means of finishing
38108.commentary: (MNa) tathā virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ. tañ'ca kho ariyamaggakkhaṇ'uppattiyā kilesānaṃ samucchedato pariccāgabhāvena ca nibbānapakkhandanabhāvena ca pariṇataṃ paripakkan'ti ayam'eva attho daṭṭhabbo.

examples.text: kathaṃ bhāvitā ca, bhikkhave, satta bojjh'aṅgā kathaṃ bahulīkatā vijjāvimuttiṃ paripūrenti ? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu satisambojjh'aṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.

38110.meaning1: truth of cessation; reality of termination; third noble truth

examples.text: vipassanā hi tīṇi lakkhaṇāni upanijjhāyatī'ti lakkhaṇ'ūpanijjhānaṃ. maggo vipassanāya āgatakiccaṃ sādhetī'ti lakkhaṇ'ūpanijjhānaṃ. phalaṃ tathalakkhaṇaṃ nirodhasaccaṃ upanijjhāyatī'ti lakkhaṇ'ūpanijjhānaṃ.
dubbhikkham'iva vā dukkhasaccaṃ, dubbuṭṭhi viya samudayasaccaṃ, subhikkham'iva nirodhasaccaṃ, suvuṭṭhi viya maggasaccaṃ.

38111.meaning1: detailed analysis of the truth of the cessation (of suffering); investigation of the third truth

examples.text: nirodhasaccaniddese yo tassā'y'eva taṇhāyā'ti ettha yo tass'eva dukkhassā'ti vattabbe yasmā samudayanirodhen'eva dukkhaṃ nirujjhati, no aññathā.

38112.meaning1: perception of ending; recognition of cessation
38112.notes: ten peceptions 1. aniccasaññā, 2. anattasaññā, 3. asubhasaññā, 4. ādīnavasaññā, 5. pahānasaññā, 6. virāgasaññā, 7. nirodhasaññā, 8. sabbaloke anabhiratasaññā, 9. sabbasaṅkhāresu anicchāsaññā, 10. ānāpānassati.

examples.text: katamā c'ānanda, nirodhasaññā? idh'ānanda, bhikkhu araññagato vā rukkhamūlagato vā suññ'āgāragato vā iti paṭisañcikkhati, etaṃ santaṃ etaṃ paṇītaṃ yadidaṃ sabbasaṅkhārasamatho sabb'ūpadhippaṭinissaggo taṇhākkhayo nirodho nibbānan'ti.
yāvakīvañ'ca, bhikkhave, bhikkhū nirodhasaññaṃ bhāvessanti

38113.meaning1: accompanied by the perception of ending; together with the recognition of cessation

examples.text: kathaṃ bhāvitā ca, bhikkhave, nirodhasaññā kathaṃ bahulīkatā mahapphalā hoti mah'ānisaṃsā? idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu nirodhasaññāsahagataṃ upekkhāsambojjh'aṅgaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
idha tvaṃ, dīghāvu, sabbasaṅkhāresu anicc'ānupassī viharāhi, anicce dukkhasaññī, dukkhe anattasaññī pahānasaññī virāgasaññī nirodhasaññī'ti. evañ'hi te, dīghāvu, sikkhitabban'ti.

38115.commentary: (SNa) nirodhasamāpatti pattabbā'ti nirodho'va nirodhasamāpatti nāma hutvā pattabbā'ti attho.

examples.text: tatiyassa jhānassa pīti kaṇṭako, catutthassa jhānassa assāsapassāso kaṇṭako, saññāvedayitanirodhasamāpattiyā saññā ca vedanā ca kaṇṭako, rāgo kaṇṭako doso kaṇṭako moho kaṇṭako.
nirodhasamāpattito vuṭṭhahitvā viya nisinnaṃ bhagavantaṃ, arahantaṃ, sammā sambuddhaṃ iminā pupphena pūjemi, pūjemi, pūjemi.

38116.meaningLit: discourse on the attainment of cessation

examples.text: asaññino vuccanti nirodhasamāpannā ye ca asaññasattā, na'pi so nirodhasamāpanno, na'pi asaññasatto.

38121.meaning2: Chapter 8 of the Bojjhaṅgasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 5 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

38122.meaning1: observing cessation; watching ending; contemplating finishing

examples.text: nirodh'ānupassī assasissāmī'ti sikkhati, nirodh'ānupassī passasissāmī'ti sikkhati.
so kāye ca sukhāya ca vedanāya anicc'ānupassī viharati, vay'ānupassī viharati, virāg'ānupassī viharati, nirodh'ānupassī viharati, paṭinissagg'ānupassī viharati.

38123.meaning1: which impedes; which hinders; which obstructs

examples.text: byāpādavitakko, bhikkhave, andhakaraṇo acakkhukaraṇo aññāṇakaraṇo paññānirodhiko vighātapakkhiko anibbānasaṃvattaniko.
so ca kho attabyābādhāya'pi saṃvattati, parabyābādhāya'pi saṃvattati, ubhayabyābādhāya'pi saṃvattati, paññānirodhiko vighātapakkhiko anibbānasaṃvattaniko

38125.meaning1: could be stopped; could be arrested; could be confined
38125.meaning2: to be destroyed; should be dissolved; should be annihilated
38125.meaningLit: to cause to be blocked down

examples.text: vātaṃ vā so jālena bādhetabbaṃ maññeyya, yo vitakkavicāre nirodhetabbaṃ maññeyya, sakamuṭṭhinā vā so gaṅgāya sotaṃ āvāretabbaṃ maññeyya, yo vitakkavicāre nirodhetabbaṃ maññeyyā'ti.

38127.meaning1: having ended; having destroyed; having annihilated
38127.meaning2: having destroyed, having dissolved, having annihilated

examples.text: yattha kāmā nirujjhanti, ye ca kāme nirodhetvā nirodhetvā viharanti, addhā te āyasmanto nicchātā nibbutā tiṇṇā pāraṅ'gatā tadaṅgenā'ti vadāmi

38132.synonym: āvuṭa, guḷha, chādita, paṭicchanna, līna, saṃvuta

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena, rañño ambo dhuvaphalo hoti. atha kho, bhikkhave, so chapako yena so ambo ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā taṃ ambaṃ abhiruhitvā nilīno acchi.

38138.meaning1: having hidden; having kept oneself out of view; having concealed oneself
38138.meaning2: having hidden, having lurked, having kept oneself hidden

examples.text: adassanena, mahārāja, māro pāpimā nilīyitvā pañcasālake brāhmaṇagahapatike anvāvisi.
yathā'pi dīpiko nāma, nilīyitvā gaṇhatī mige, tath'ev'āyaṃ buddhaputto, yuttayogo vipassako, araññaṃ pavisitvāna, gaṇhāti phalam'uttaman'ti.

38140.grammar: pp of caus of nī √lañch, caus

examples.text: dvādasa vassāni ahaṃ, nillacchito dārake parivahitvā, kiminā'v'aṭṭo akallo, yathā'pi gantvāna paradāraṃ.

38142.meaning1: not talkative; not chatty; not loquacious

examples.text: ye ca kho te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū nikkuhā nillapā dhīrā atthaddhā susamāhitā, te kho me, bhikkhave, bhikkhū māmakā. anapagatā ca te, bhikkhave, bhikkhū imasmā dhammavinayā. te ca imasmiṃ dhammavinaye vuddhiṃ viruḷhiṃ vepullaṃ āpajjantī'ti.
nikkuhā nillapā dhīrā, atthaddhā susamāhitā, te ve dhamme virūhanti, sammāsambuddhadesite'ti.

38143.meaning1: (of the tongue) having stuck out; having blown a raspberry
38143.meaning2: having wagged (the tongue); having moved the tongue to and fro
38143.commentary: (SNa) jivhaṃ nillāletvā'ti kabaramahājivhaṃ nīharitvā uddham'adho ubhayapassesu ca lāletvā.

examples.text: sandiṭṭhiko ayaṃ dhammo akāliko ehipassiko opaneyyiko paccattaṃ veditabbo viññūhī'ti. evaṃ vutte, māro pāpimā sīsaṃ okampetvā jivhaṃ nillāletvā tivisākhaṃ nalāṭe nalāṭikaṃ vuṭṭhāpetvā daṇḍam'olubbha pakkāmi.

38144.meaning1: (of the tongue) having stuck out; having blown a raspberry

examples.text: evaṃ vutte daṇḍapāṇi sakko sīsaṃ okampetvā, jivhaṃ nillāḷetvā, tivisākhaṃ nalāṭikaṃ nalāṭe vuṭṭhāpetvā daṇḍam'olubbha pakkāmi.

38146.meaning1: having scraped off; having stripped away

examples.text: na hatthanillehakaṃ bhuñjissāmī'ti sikkhā karaṇīyā.
anāpatti asañcicca, assatiyā, ajānantassa, gilānassa, parittake sese ekato saṅkaḍḍhitvā nillehitvā bhuñjati, āpadāsu, ummattakassa, ādikammikassā'ti.

yadā mayaṃ jānāma kālaṅ'kato so puriso'ti, atha naṃ kumbhiṃ oropetvā ubbhinditvā mukhaṃ vivaritvā saṇikaṃ nillokema, app'eva nāmassa jīvaṃ nikkhamantaṃ passeyyāmā'ti. n'ev'assa mayaṃ jīvaṃ nikkhamantaṃ passāma.
tīhi, bhikkhave, aṅgehi samannāgato mahācoro sandhim'pi chindati, nillopam'pi harati, ek'āgārikam'pi karoti, paripanthe'pi tiṭṭhati. katamehi tīhi?
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, kāmahetu kāmanidānaṃ kām'ādhikaraṇaṃ kāmānam'eva hetu sandhim'pi chindanti, nillopam'pi haranti, ek'āgārikam'pi karonti, paripanthe'pi tiṭṭhanti, paradāram'pi gacchanti.

38152.meaning1: hairless state; fact of having the hair removed

38154.meaning1: fabrication; fiction; invention; (comm) accumulation of merit and demerit

examples.text: anejassa vijānato, n'atthi kāci nisaṅkhati, virato so viyārabbhā, khemaṃ passati sabbadhi.
anejassa vijānato, n'atthi kāci nisaṅkhiti, virato so viyārabbhā, khemaṃ passati sabbadhi.
nisajja kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi
nisīdi bhagavā paññatte āsane. nisajja pāde pakkhālesi.
evañ'hi so, bhikkhave, goṇo kiṭṭh'ādo gāmagato vā araññagato vā, ṭhānabahulo vā assa nisajjabahulo vā na taṃ kiṭṭhaṃ puna otareyya, tam'eva purimaṃ daṇḍasamphassaṃ samanussaranto.
yo pana bhikkhu mātugāmena saddhiṃ eko ekāya raho paṭicchanne āsane alaṃkammaniye nisajjaṃ kappeyya
yo pana bhikkhu bhikkhuniyā saddhiṃ eko ekāya raho nisajjaṃ kappeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
divasaṃ caṅkamena nisajjāya āvaraṇīyehi dhammehi cittaṃ parisodhessāma

atha kho bhagavā bahu'd'eva rattiṃ abbhokāse nisajjāya vītināmetvā pāde pakkhāletvā vihāraṃ pāvisi. āyasmā'pi kho soṇo bahu'd'eva rattiṃ abbhokāse nisajjāya vītināmetvā pāde pakkhāletvā vihāraṃ pāvisi.
yo pana bhikkhu sabhojane kule anupakhajja nisajjaṃ kappeyya, pācittiyaṃ.
yo pana bhikkhu mātugāmena saddhiṃ eko ekāya raho paṭicchanne āsane, alaṃkammaniye, nisajjaṃ kappeyya

38167.meaning2: stone for grinding; (upper, smaller) millstone or stone roller

examples.text: so n'eva ussādetabbo na apasādetabbo, anussādetvā anapasādetvā sv'eva sādhukaṃ saññāpetabbo tassa ca atthassa tesañ'ca byañjanānaṃ nisantiyā.

38169.meaning1: who learns; who pays attention (to); who observes

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo khippanisantī ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu, sutānañ'ca dhammānaṃ dhārakajātiko hoti, dhātānañ'ca dhammānaṃ atth'ūpaparikkhī hoti attham'aññāya dhammam'aññāya, dhamm'ānudhammappaṭipanno hoti.

38171.meaning1: leading bull; finest of men; (comm) foremost of a hundred thousand bulls
38171.commentary: (MNa) nisabhassā'ti usabhavasabhanisabhesu sabbattha appaṭisamaṭṭhena nisabhassa. (SNa) gavasatajeṭṭhako hi usabho, gavasahassajeṭṭhako vasabho, gavasatasahassajeṭṭhako nisabho'ti vuccati.

examples.text: nisabho vata, bho, samaṇo gotamo, nisabhavatā ca samuppannā sārīrikā vedanā dukkhā tibbā kharā kaṭukā asātā amanāpā sato sampajāno adhivāseti avihaññamāno'ti.

38173.meaning1: what is called the chief bull

38175.meaning1: who has leading bull-like qualities; who has noble character

examples.text: nisabho vata, bho, samaṇo gotamo, nisabhavatā ca samuppannā sārīrikā vedanā dukkhā tibbā kharā kaṭukā asātā amanāpā sato sampajāno adhivāseti avihaññamāno'ti.
uṭṭhānavato satīmato, sucikammassa nisammakārino, saññatassa dhammajīvino, appamattassa yaso'bhivaḍḍhati.

38177.commentary: (NIDD2) ādiccabandhussa vaco nisammā'ti ādiccabandhussa vacanaṃ byappathaṃ desanaṃ anusāsanaṃ anusiṭṭhaṃ sutvā suṇitvā uggahetvā upadhārayitvā upalakkhayitvā'ti, ādiccabandhussa vaco nisamma, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.

examples.text: aṭṭhānataṃ saṅgaṇikāratassa, yaṃ phassaye sāmayikaṃ vimuttiṃ, ādiccabandhussa vaco nisamma, eko care khaggavisāṇakappo.
imehi te hīnakāy'ūpapannā, deve tāvatiṃse abhikkamanti, saṃvegajātassa vaco nisamma, so gopako vāsavam'ajjhabhāsi.

38178.meaning1: acting calmly; behaving considerately; acting carefully; acting politely
38178.commentary: (DHPa) nisammakārino'ti evañ'ce bhavissati, evaṃ karissāmī'ti vā, imasmiṃ kamme evaṃ kate idaṃ nāma bhavissatī'ti vā evaṃ nidānaṃ sallakkhetvā rogatikicchanaṃ viya sabbakammāni nisāmetvā upadhāretvā karontassa. (JAa) anisammakārī'ti kiñci sutvā anupadhāretvā attano paccakkhaṃ akatvā kārako.

examples.text: uṭṭhānavato satīmato, sucikammassa nisammakārino, saññatassa dhammajīvino, appamattassa yaso'bhivaḍḍhati.
nisamma khattiyo kayirā, n'ānisamma disampati, nisammakārino rāja, yaso kitti ca vaḍḍhatī'ti.

38182.commentary: (DNa) āpāthakanisādī hotī'ti manussānaṃ āpāthe dassanaṭṭhāne nisīdati. (KVt) yo pana ārāmo yebhuyyena vā aparikkhitto hoti, sakalo'pi vā, so gonisādī'ti vuccati.

examples.text: gāmo nāma ekakuṭiko'pi gāmo, dvikuṭiko'pi gāmo, tikuṭiko'pi gāmo, catukuṭiko'pi gāmo, samanusso'pi gāmo, amanusso'pi gāmo, parikkhitto'pi gāmo, aparikkhitto'pi gāmo, gonisādiniviṭṭho'pi gāmo, yo'pi sattho atirekacatumāsaniviṭṭho so'pi vuccati gāmo.
puna caparaṃ, nigrodha, tapassī āpāthakanisādī hoti… ayam'pi kho, nigrodha, tapassino upakkileso hoti.

38185.meaning2: naturally disposed to attending carefully; given to closely observing

38186.meaning1: heeded; listened attentively; paid close attention

examples.text: pure puratthā purimāsu jātisu, aññātu'kāmo paripucchitā ahu, sussūsitā pabbajitaṃ upāsitā, atth'antaro atthakathaṃ nisāmayi.
tasmā hi bhūtā nisāmetha sabbe, mettaṃ karotha mānusiyā pajāya, divā ca ratto ca haranti ye baliṃ, tasmā hi ne rakkhatha appamattā.

38189.meaning2: having listened to, having observed, having attended to

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, matajaṃ nāma āvudhajātaṃ ubhatodhāraṃ pītanisitaṃ. tadassa saṅghāṭiyā sampārutaṃ sampaliveṭhitaṃ. tath'ūpam'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, imassa bhikkhuno pabbajjaṃ vadāmi.
pallaṅkena nisinnassa, jaṇṇuke n'ābhivassati, alaṃ phāsuvihārāya, pahit'attassa bhikkhuno.
puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, bhikkhu gacchanto vā gacchāmī'ti pajānāti ṭhito vā ṭhito'mhī'ti pajānāti nisinno vā nisinno'mhī'ti pajānāti sayāno vā sayāno'mhī'ti pajānāti
asite pīte khāyite sāyite sampajānakārī ahosiṃ, uccārapassāvakamme sampajānakārī ahosiṃ, gate ṭhite nisinne sutte jāgarite bhāsite tuṇhībhāve sampajānakārī ahosiṃ.

38195.construction:
ni + sīda + na + ka
nisinna + ka
38195.commentary: (PMa) nisinnako vā nipannako vā'ti nisinno vā nipanno vā.

examples.text: acchariyaṃ vata, bho, abbhutaṃ vata, bho! ayaṃ samaṇo nisinnako'va kālaṅ'kato! handa naṃ dahāmā'ti.
āma, samma, idāni ahaṃ vihāraṃ gantvā theraṃ tayā kāritapaṇṇasālāya nisinnakaṃ disvā āgatomhī'ti vatvā pakkāmi.

38196.meaning1: time when seated; time of sitting

examples.text: ayya sumedhatāpasa, porāṇakabodhisattānaṃ pallaṅkaṃ ābhujitvā, pāramiyo vicinissāmā'ti nisinnakāle yāni pubbanimittāni nāma paññāyanti, tāni sabbāni'pi ajja pātubhūtāni
āsanasālāya nisinnakāle yāguṃ vā bhattaṃ vā gahetvā nisinnakāle paribhuñjitvā nisinnakāle divāvihāraṭṭhāna-gamanakāle'pi.
tañ'ce bhikkhuṃ aññe bhikkhū jāneyyuṃ nisinnapubbaṃ iminā bhikkhunā dvattikkhattuṃ pātimokkhe uddissamāne, ko pana vādo bhiyyo, na ca tassa bhikkhuno aññāṇakena mutti atthi

38199.meaning1: (sutta) which discusses the foolish cowherd in detail, the foolish monk in detail, the wise cowherd in detail and the wise monk in detail
38199.meaning2: sutta in which e.g. the bad herdsman, bad monk, good herdsman and good monk are each treated right to the conclusion before the next is started
38199.commentary: (ANa) apaṇḍitagopālakaṃ dassetvā pariyosānagamanaṃ, apaṇḍitabhikkhuṃ dassetvā pariyosānagamanaṃ, paṇḍitagopālakaṃ dassetvā pariyosānagamanaṃ, paṇḍitabhikkhuṃ dassetvā pariyosānagamanan'ti ayaṃ nisinnavattikā nāma.
38199.notes: three kinds of discourses 1. ekanāḷika, 2. caturassa, 3. nisinnavattika
